name: ERC-4626-Style Inflation Attack
threat_model: An early depositor donates assets to a nearly empty vault, inflating the share price so a later deposit rounds down and transfers value to the early depositor.
assumptions: The vault is an ERC-4626-style share-accounting example, not a full IERC4626 implementation.
The remediated example assumes exact-transfer, non-rebasing assets and rejects deposits that deliver less than requested.
Virtual asset/share values mitigate the tested donation but do not prevent every inflation scenario.
invariant: Depositors receive shares for measured assets received, and deposits that round to zero shares revert without taking assets.

detector_expectations.expectation: share-price rounding and donation economics are not established by static analysis
